$ docker image inspect myorg/app:1.2 ; docker tag myorg/app:1.2 reg.io/y:2 ; docker rmi reg.io/y:2 ;
$ docker image inspect sha256:0123456789ab ; docker rmi -f 0123abcd
(09 to 13: the requests of CLI 29.9.3 against a recorder that answered 200/201 with canned bodies,
 2026-11-16: `GET /v1.52/images/{name}/json`, `POST .../tag?repo=&tag=`, `DELETE .../images/{name}`,
 each after the CLI's `HEAD /_ping`. The build's own 200 is the stream the native tests' real CLI reads.)
